# Helvety Store

> Official Helvety Store. Products and apps engineered and designed in Switzerland.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://helvety.com/store): Browse the Helvety product catalog
- [Products](https://helvety.com/store/products): Full listing of Helvety products and apps
- [SPO Explorer](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-spo-explorer): SharePoint Online Explorer with public package download
- [Helvety PDF](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-pdf): Free PDF toolkit with browser-based processing for supported operations
- [Helvety Tasks](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-tasks): Free E2E encrypted task management
- [Helvety Contacts](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-contacts): Free E2E encrypted contact management
- [Helvety Notes](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-notes): Free E2E encrypted notes management

## Helvety Ecosystem
- [Helvety](https://helvety.com): Main Helvety website with company information and legal pages
- [Helvety PDF](https://helvety.com/pdf): Free PDF toolkit with browser-based processing for supported operations
- [Helvety Auth](https://helvety.com/auth): Centralized authentication for all Helvety apps
- [Helvety Contacts](https://helvety.com/contacts): Contact management with client-side encryption for sensitive fields
- [Helvety Notes](https://helvety.com/notes): Notes management with client-side encryption for sensitive fields
- [Helvety Tasks](https://helvety.com/tasks): Task management with client-side encryption for sensitive fields

## Optional
- [GitHub](https://github.com/CasparRubin/helvety): Public monorepo for all Helvety applications (open source under MIT)
